note: Small primitive state-park campground below Fremont Peak in the Gabilan Range, 11 miles up paved, winding San Juan Canyon Road from San Juan Bautista. Only Valley View's sites VV02-VV09 take a 25-ft pad. --Claude

FIT: brochure 'trailers or vehicles over 25 feet in length are not recommended' (road + campground). Only Valley View VV02-VV09 have 25-ft pads (VV10 15 ft, VV11 19 ft); Oak Point VV16-VV25 are tent sites. A 23-ft rig fits 8 reservable sites. The old note's 'RV-capable sites 1,2,3,5,6,7,9,10,11' does not match RC's numbering and was dropped.
